name: Home
notes: Round house on the lake with the map wall.

name: Woodland Mansion
notes: Big dark-oak mansion. Evokers and vindicators inside — go armoured. Totems of undying from evokers.

name: Pillager outpost (west)
notes: Outpost tower beside a dark-oak building. Crossbow pillagers; check the cage for an allay.

name: Sulfur springs (west)
notes: Sulfur mounds in the forest.

name: Big ravine
notes: Deep open ravine with waterfalls, exposed stone layers and a cave mouth at the bottom. Good ore hunting.

name: Sulfur springs (ravine)
notes: Second sulfur springs, seen from above. The pale sparkly stuff is sulfur, not diamonds.

name: Sandstone cliff
notes: Tall sandstone and sand cliff dropping to the water. Easy sandstone.

name: Stone mountain
notes: Bare stone and gravel peaks with terraces. Stone, gravel, coal; watch the drops.

name: Longhorn cows (lake)
notes: Brown long-horned cows by the lake. Lead with wheat.

name: Woodland tent (west)
notes: Small canvas tent: white canopy, birch posts, hay bales, a chest. This is where the explorer map came from.

name: Explorer map spot
notes: Where the explorer map was unrolled after finding it in the tent to the north. Come back here when it is time to use it.

name: Deepslate spire
notes: Tall cobbled-deepslate spike on a hill. Looks like someone's marker; unknown what it marks.

name: Ocean Monument
notes: Prismarine monument with sea lanterns. Guardians inside — bring water breathing and a conduit plan. Sponges in the sponge room.

name: Ocean Ruins
notes: Stone-brick underwater ruins. Chests with buried-treasure maps; drowned around.

name: Shipwreck (NW beach)
notes: Beached shipwreck. Three chest spots: bow, stern, hold.

name: Woodland tent (east)
notes: Canvas tent with chest and pink flowers. Explorer map found here.

name: Big cave mouth
notes: Tall deepslate cave entrance opening right onto the water.

name: Mountain bridge
notes: Simple log bridge between two peaks.

name: Taiga village (west)
notes: Spruce village with villagers. The fenced pen with longhorn cows, a pig and a composter at (-3730, -327) is its farm.

name: Llamas
notes: Llamas on the grass under the snowy peaks; cherry grove nearby. The cold frog hut is on the peak above.

name: Swamp (east)
notes: Lily pads, clay, slimes at night, frogs.

name: Autumn forest
notes: Red and orange autumn forest across the water.

name: Giant mushrooms
notes: Huge red mushrooms — mushroom blocks and mushrooms for stew.

name: Bamboo jungle (east)
notes: Bamboo and birch at the jungle edge. Warm biome: tadpoles raised here come out white.

name: Shipwreck (south beach)
notes: Second shipwreck, beached by the birch forest.

name: Taiga village
notes: Spruce village: berries, pumpkins, barrels. A pillager outpost stands right beside it at (-855, 673) and a woodland tent at (-845, 672) — explorer map found there.

name: Snowy village
notes: Snowy village by the frozen water.

name: Igloo
notes: Bed, crafting table, furnace. Check under the carpet for the basement ladder.

name: Woodland tent (south)
notes: Canvas tent with hay and blue flowers, beside a giant red mushroom.

name: Sulfur springs (east)
notes: Sulfur mounds on red terracotta ground.

name: Sulfur springs (pool)
notes: The largest springs, with a water pool, next to the flower field.

name: Swamp (south)
notes: Swamp with a huge brown mushroom at the edge. Closest swamp to the snowy village.

name: Skeleton spawner XP farm
notes: Spawner farm built into the cliff over the water: beds, chests, furnaces, glass cases. Sign reads "Watch them zoom by!". Bones, arrows, XP.

name: Parrots, ocelots, pandas
notes: Parrots (tame with seeds), ocelots (raw cod or salmon) and pandas (bamboo; need 8 bamboo nearby to breed). A mineshaft runs underneath at (-2690, 18, 893).

name: Plains village
notes: Farms, bell, mountains behind. Closest village to Home, ~1,300 blocks south.

name: Pillager outpost (lake)
notes: Outpost tower standing in the water; pillagers on the shore.

name: Slime chunk
notes: Computed Bedrock slime chunk (x -2448 to -2433, z -464 to -449). Dig a dark room below y 40 for slimeballs; any light level works. Toggle Slime on the map to see the rest.

name: North cabin
notes: Temporary lodging with a Nether portal, built while scouting for basalt deltas. Nether side at (-22, -218) in a warped forest. 580 blocks north of the map wall.

name: Frog hut (cold)
notes: Cobblestone hut on the peak with a breeding pair; tadpoles raised here come out green. Pool is roofed so it cannot freeze. Reach by boat up the river east of Home to the mountain foot at about (-1760, -620). Portal here was removed — it linked to the one near Home.

name: Jungle base
notes: Base at the foot of a jungle tree on the river. The riverbank is River biome (temperate), so the growing pool sits back in the bamboo — tadpoles come out white.

name: Swamp house
notes: Oak A-frame with a chimney by a giant red mushroom. Temporary house for frog and slime hunting.

name: North portal (snowy)
notes: Portal on the snow among spruce. Linked correctly to Nether (-258, 89, -256) in a crimson forest — hoglins and piglins there.

name: Pillager outpost (lake, west)
notes: Outpost tower on a headland over the water, west of the skeleton farm.

name: Cherry village
notes: Plains village with a bell, horses, cherry trees in view. ~700 blocks NW of Home.

name: Snowy outpost
notes: Outpost in the flower meadow with snowy peaks behind, 90 blocks from the north village and ~300 from the snowy portal. Pillagers with crossbows.

name: North village
notes: Village with a meeting-point tree and lanterns, next to the snowy outpost. Nearest village to the snowy portal.

name: Home portal
notes: The Nether portal near Home, under the cherry trees with lanterns. Nether side at (-307, 61, -31).

name: Spider spawner (dig down)
notes: Bamboo scaffold tower marks the spot — dig straight down from here to reach a spider spawner. 135 blocks E of Home across the water.

name: NW village
notes: Plains village with villagers, at the far NW corner of the Home L4. ~1,800 blocks NW of Home.

name: Woodland tent (north)
notes: Canvas tent with a chest and a small garden, cherry blossoms nearby.

name: Floating rock
notes: Big floating stone island over a flowery valley with a stream — a natural oddity, easy to spot from the air.

name: Spider spawner (north)
notes: Cave spider seen at the surface here, below the snowy outpost — a spawner is likely close by. Pumpkins nearby.

name: Mountain cave (lush)
biome: Snowy / stony peak, lush cave inside
notes: Cave in the mountain at y 143 with lush-cave vines and glow berries — a good lush cave for axolotls and berries.

name: Cave mouth (birch)
notes: Big dark cave opening in the hillside among birch trees.

name: Birch forest
notes: Tall birch forest north of the wall — birch logs if you need them.
